title: 第16章 有些离谱的别墅
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
两人穿过几条街道，绕过一座巨大的喷泉，前方出现一片低矮的围墙。

    围墙由某种灰白色的石材砌成，约莫两人高，墙头每隔一段距离就立着一根骨柱，柱顶燃烧着幽绿的火焰。

    “宿舍区到了。”霍尔顿停下脚步，朝围墙指了指，“进去之后自己找。天才区在东边最里面。我懒得进去了，你自己走。”

    他说完，转身就要离开。

    “师兄。”伊森叫住他。

    霍尔顿回过头：“还有事？”

    伊森从怀里摸出那枚从飞艇少女身上缴获的银色发钗，递了过去：“这个，值多少？”

    霍尔顿接过发钗，翻来覆去看了两眼，挑了挑眉。

    “寒霜发钗。”他随口说道，“学徒级巫器，灌入精神力就能激发寒霜箭。威力一般，对付普通人还行，对上三等学徒就是挠痒痒。不过材料还算凑合，能卖个十块魔石左右。”

    他把发钗扔回给伊森：“想卖的话，去中央广场西边的交易区。那里有专门的铺子收这些东西，价格公道。”

    伊森点了点头，把发钗收回怀里。

    霍尔顿摆了摆手，转身消失在夜色中。

    伊森推开宿舍区的门，走了进去。

    围墙内是一条笔直的石道，贯穿整个宿舍区。石道两侧分叉出无数条小径，通往各个不同的区域。每片区域入口都立着一块石碑，上面刻着名字。

    伊森沿着石道往前走。

    路过庸才区时，他扫了一眼那些低矮的、密密麻麻排列的单身宿舍，然后收回目光，继续往前走。

    石道逐渐变得宽敞，两侧的建筑也开始发生变化。

    那些低矮的单身宿舍逐渐消失，取而代之的是稀疏的独立院落。

    每个院落都有一圈低矮的围墙，院内是一栋两三层的小楼，楼前往往种着些不知名的植物，在夜色中泛着微弱的荧光。

    又走了约莫一刻钟，前方出现一块石碑。

    天才区。

    伊森停下脚步，取出那枚晶石。

    滴血激活后，晶石表面亮起微弱的荧光，一股隐隐的牵引感从眉心传来，指向天才区深处。

    他顺着那感觉往前走。

    小径两侧的院落越来越稀疏，每一座都更加精致。有的楼前有小花园，有的带着喷泉，有的甚至有一小片树林。

    终于，在一块刻着“七十七”的石碑前，伊森停下脚步。

    眼前的院落占地至少有两百平米，一圈齐腰高的白色石墙围成规整的长方形。墙内是一栋三层小楼，通体由某种淡青色的石材砌成，在夜色中泛着柔和的微光。楼前有一小片草坪，草坪中央是一棵三四米高的树，树上挂着几枚淡金色的果实，散发着淡淡的清香。

    伊森推开院门。
content_en:
The two walked through several streets and bypassed a huge fountain. A low wall appeared in front of them.

    The wall is made of some kind of gray-white stone, about two people high. There are bone pillars standing at regular intervals on the top of the wall, and the top of the pillar is burning with green flames.

    "We've arrived at the dormitory area." Holden stopped and pointed toward the wall, "Go in and look for yourself. The genius area is at the innermost east side. I'm too lazy to go in, so you can go by yourself."

    After he finished speaking, he turned around and left.

    "Senior brother." Ethan called him.

    Holden turned back: "Is there anything else?"

    Ethan took out the silver hairpin seized from the airship girl from his arms and handed it over: "How much is this worth?"

    Holden took the hairpin, looked at it over and over, and raised his eyebrows.

    "Frost hairpin." He said casually, "Apprentice-level witchcraft, pouring spiritual power into it can activate frost arrows. The power is average, and it's okay against ordinary people. It's just scratching against third-class apprentices. But the materials are pretty good, and it can be sold for about ten magic stones."

    He threw the hairpin back to Ethan: "If you want to sell it, go to the trading area west of the Central Square. There are special shops there that collect these things, and the prices are fair."

    Ethan nodded and took the hairpin back into his arms.

    Holden waved his hand, turned around and disappeared into the night.

    Ethan pushed open the door to the dormitory area and walked in.

    Inside the wall is a straight stone path that runs through the entire dormitory area. Countless paths branch off on both sides of the stone path, leading to different areas. At the entrance to each area is a stone tablet with a name engraved on it.

    Ethan walked forward along the stone path.

    When passing by the mediocre area, he glanced at the low, densely packed single dormitories, then withdrew his gaze and continued walking forward.

    The stone path gradually became wider, and the buildings on both sides began to change.

    Those low-rise single dormitories gradually disappeared and were replaced by sparse independent courtyards.

    Each courtyard has a low wall. Inside the courtyard is a two- or three-story building. There are often some unknown plants planted in front of the building, glowing with faint fluorescence in the night.

    After walking for about a quarter of an hour, a stone tablet appeared in front of us.

    Genius Zone.

    Ethan stopped and took out the crystal.

    After the blood drop was activated, a faint fluorescence lit up on the surface of the crystal, and a faint pulling feeling came from the center of the eyebrows, pointing to the depths of the genius zone.

    He followed the feeling.

    The courtyards on both sides of the path are getting sparser and sparse, each one more exquisite. Some buildings have small gardens in front of them, some have fountains, and some even have a small forest.

    Finally, in front of a stone tablet engraved with "Seventy-seven", Ethan stopped.

    The courtyard in front of you covers an area of ​​at least two hundred square meters, and is surrounded by a waist-high white stone wall forming a regular rectangle. Inside the wall is a three-story building, which is made of some kind of light cyan stone and glows softly in the night. There is a small lawn in front of the building. In the center of the lawn is a tree three to four meters high. There are several pale golden fruits hanging on the tree, exuding a faint fragrance.

    Ethan pushed open the courtyard door.
